title: Additive and multiplicative densities, prime valuations and symbolic models
summary: We study additive and multiplicative densities of subsets of $\N$ along prescribed Følner sequences. We prove that additive upper density one implies multiplicative density one along a suitable multiplicative Følner sequence. We also prove independence in the following sense: given an additive Følner sequence $(G_n)_n$, a multiplicative Følner sequence $(F_n)_n$, and any $(α,β)\in[0,1]^2$, we construct a single set $A\subseteq\N$ such that $\dens_{(G_n)_n}(A)=α$ and $\md_{(F_n)_n}(A)=β$.
